title: Aurora Farmers' Market & Artisan Fair
summary: Shop local produce, baked goods, small-batch coffee and crafts in Aurora Town Park with live acoustic sets and a kids' creative corner running all season long.
description: Celebrate Saturday mornings with over 40 vendors featuring farm-fresh produce, local honey, artisan breads, florals, handmade gifts and more. Enjoy rotating food trucks, chef demos, and a dedicated kids' tent with crafts and story time. Bring your own bags and water bottles—fountain refills available on-site.
priceNote: Vendors set their own pricing for goods.
